def dp(x: int) -> int:
    p = 1
    for ch in str(x):
        p *= int(ch)
    return p
t = int(input().strip())
for _ in range(t):
    n = int(input().strip())
    arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
    arr.sort(key=lambda x: (dp(x), x))
    print(*arr)

def product_of_digits(x):
    prod = 1
    while x > 0:
        prod *= x % 10
        x //= 10
    return prod
t = int(input())
for _ in range(t):
    n = int(input())
    arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
    arr.sort(key=lambda x: (product_of_digits(x), x))
    print(*arr)

def tich_chu_so(so):
    if so == 0:
        return 0

    tich = 1
    while so > 0:
        chu_so = so % 10
        tich = tich * chu_so
        so = so // 10         
    return tich
t = int(input())
for _ in range(t):
    n = int(input())
    day = list(map(int, input().split()))
    ds_tich = []
    for so in day:
        tich = tich_chu_so(so)
        ds_tich.append((tich, so))  
    ds_tich.sort()
    for tich, so in ds_tich:
        print(so, end=" ")
    print()
